data: This introductory and interdisciplinary course focuses on human/animal stories to explore socio-cultural worldviews especially in relation to identity, social justice and the redistribution of natural resources, particularly in South Asia. Through ethnographies, films, novels and paintings we will explore the lives of those living in communities which depend on or live close to wild animals. The course aims to be an informative, provocative and a fun introduction to an exciting and relatively new field of scholarship.
